title: FOUNDATIONAL AUTOMATIC EVALUATORS: SCALING MULTI-TASK GENERATIVE EVALUATOR TRAINING FOR REASONING-CENTRIC DOMAINS
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing and benchmarking automatic evaluators for reasoning-centric domains such as math, logic, and coding. While it uses some safety-related training data (HH-RLHF and Beavertails), its primary evaluation benchmarks (JudgeBench, ProcessBench, etc.) do not focus on religion, morals, or ethics.
